title: Human-approved bounded hardware research and follow-up
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's 2026-08-31 request to proceed with the proposed hardware investigation and optional follow-up research. Scope is the twenty existing research units under canonical ARCH-01, ARCH-02, ARCH-03, ARCH-04, ARCH-05, ARCH-12 and SSW-05, displayed as ARCH-001/002/003/004/005/009/012. Investigate public primary information, record bilingual provisional comparisons, supply/software and measurement conditions, evidence-supported roadmap timing and cross-system dependencies. Optional follow-up prioritizes performance comparability, access/software, dependencies, unresolved Hot Chips evidence, public procurement boundaries, counterevidence and forecast-versus-actual history within these topics. This is publication-scope authorization for reviewable Pages data, not approval of the scientific conclusions. Preserve a single-agent/single-model provisional state, open Gaps, historical evidence and incomplete Consensus. Do not merge the PR, deploy production, enable unattended agents, access restricted information, or infer costs/availability from unmatched evidence.
